mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals a weak labor market that typically triggers central bank intervention, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates policy support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages indicates strengthening consumer demand and construction activity, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below its 6-month moving average), the market prices in a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 2.5%, it signals rising inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors adjust to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of employment growth (PAYEMS above 100,000 monthly net additions) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100,000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 (index, 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and mining activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in reduced economic output.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.
